prior_report_citation.value: Index case not previously reported; Table 3 'Cases of pediatric patients with HA20 reported in the literature' (15 cases) cites references (2)–(12)

age_at_onset_original_text.value: presented with toothache and fever of 38°C 10 days ago (before admission at 3 years and 6 months old)

age_at_last_evaluation_original_text.value: Ten months later, we saw this child in our clinic

treatment_summary.value: Antibiotics for 3 days as outpatient and piperacillin-tazobactam on admission without improvement; acyclovir, meropenem, fluconazole and gamma globulin 2 g/kg (fever subsided); prednisone 1 mg/kg qd (fever improved, oral ulcers persisted), then gradually reduced; after WES, methotrexate 5 mg qw and thalidomide 12.5 mg qd added, after which no more oral ulcers; CRP and PCT normal and no recurrent fever or oral ulcers at 10-month follow-up.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Whole exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous TNFAIP3 mutation (c.653del p.Leu218TrpfsTer10), derived from the father, "consistent with HA20", in a child with recurrent high fever, rash, oral ulcers, lymphadenopathy and elevated inflammatory markers unresponsive to anti-infective treatment.
